```{r}
#| label: dm_prev
#| warning: false


z<-1.96
prev_100<-data.frame(
  CALYR=as.numeric(),
  DATA_SRC=as.character(),
  D=as.numeric(),
  N=as.numeric(),
  PREV_TYPE = as.character()
) %>%
  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,DM,ALL) %>% rename(D=DM,N=ALL) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "DM")) %>%
  # bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,T2DM,ALL) %>% rename(D=T2DM,N=ALL) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "T2DM")) %>%
  # bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,T1DM,ALL) %>% rename(D=T1DM,N=ALL) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "T1DM")) %>%
  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,ALS_DM,ALS) %>% rename(D=ALS_DM,N=ALS) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "DMinALS")) %>%
  # bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,ALS_T2DM,ALS) %>% rename(D=ALS_T2DM,N=ALS) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "T2DMinALS")) %>%
  # bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,ALS_T1DM,ALS) %>% rename(D=ALS_T1DM,N=ALS) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "T1DMinALS")) %>%
  mutate(
    p = D/N,
    lb = (p+z^2/(2*N)-sqrt((p*(1-p)/N)+z^2/(4*N)))/(1+z^2/N),
    ub = (p+z^2/(2*N)+sqrt((p*(1-p)/N)+z^2/(4*N)))/(1+z^2/N),
  )

ggplot(
  prev_100 %>% filter(CALYR < 9999 & DATA_SRC %in% c("EHR","MIX")) %>% 
    mutate(p_rs=p*100,lb_rs=lb*100,ub_rs=ub*100,p_rs_label=round(p_rs,1)),
  aes(x=CALYR,y=p_rs,color=PREV_TYPE)
) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lb_rs,ymax=ub_rs),width=0.5)+
  # geom_label_repel(aes(label=p_rs_label)) + 
  facet_wrap(~DATA_SRC,ncol=3,scale="free")+
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "DM prevalance (%)",
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2011, 2020, 1),
    labels = seq(2011, 2020, 1)
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12,face="bold")
  )

ggsave(file.path(path_to_res,"dm_prev.pdf"),width = 10, height = 4)
```

```{r}
#| label: als_prev
#| warning: false


alpha<-0.05
prev_100K<-data.frame(
  CALYR=as.numeric(),
  DATA_SRC=as.character(),
  D=as.numeric(),
  N=as.numeric(),
  PREV_TYPE = as.character()
) %>%
  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,ALS,ALL) %>% rename(D=ALS,N=ALL) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "ALS")) %>%
  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,ALS_DM,DM) %>% rename(D=ALS_DM,N=DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "ALSinDM")) %>%
  # bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,ALS_T2DM,T2DM) %>% rename(D=ALS_T2DM,N=T2DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "ALSinT2DM")) %>%
  # bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,ALS_T1DM,T1DM) %>% rename(D=ALS_T1DM,N=T1DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "ALSinT1DM")) %>%
  mutate(
    p = D/N,
    lb = qbeta(alpha/2, shape1 = D, shape2 = N-D + 1),
    ub = qbeta(1 - alpha/2, D + 1, N - D)
  )

ggplot(
  prev_100K %>% filter(CALYR < 9999 & DATA_SRC %in% c("EHR","MIX")) %>% 
    mutate(p_rs=p*100000,lb_rs=lb*100000,ub_rs=ub*100000),
  aes(x=CALYR,y=p_rs,color=PREV_TYPE)
) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lb_rs,ymax=ub_rs),width=0.5)+
  facet_wrap(~DATA_SRC,ncol=3,scale="free")+
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "ALS prevelance (per 100,000)",
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2011, 2020, 1),
    labels = seq(2011, 2020, 1)
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12,face="bold")
  )

ggsave(file.path(path_to_res,"als_prev.pdf"),width = 10, height = 4)

```

```{r}
#| label: als_inc
#| warning: false

alpha<-0.05
inc_100K<-data.frame(
  CALYR=as.numeric(),
  DATA_SRC=as.character(),
  D=as.numeric(),
  N=as.numeric(),
  PREV_TYPE = as.character()
) %>%
  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,newALS_DM,ALL) %>% rename(D=newALS_DM,N=ALL) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "IncALS")) %>%
  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,newALS_DM,DM) %>% rename(D=newALS_DM,N=DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "IncALSinDM")) %>%
  # bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,newALS_T2DM,T2DM) %>% rename(D=newALS_T2DM,N=T2DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "IncALSinT2DM")) %>%
  # bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,newALS_T1DM,T1DM) %>% rename(D=newALS_T1DM,N=T1DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "IncALSinT1DM")) %>%
  mutate(
    p = D/N,
    lb = 1/N*qpois(alpha/2,D),
    ub = 1/N*qpois(1-alpha/2,D+1)
  )

ggplot(
  inc_100K %>% filter(CALYR < 9999 & DATA_SRC %in% c("EHR","MIX")) %>% 
    mutate(p_rs=p*100000,lb_rs=lb*100000,ub_rs=ub*100000),
  aes(x=CALYR,y=p_rs,color=PREV_TYPE)
) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lb_rs,ymax=ub_rs),width=0.5)+
  facet_wrap(~DATA_SRC,ncol=3,scale="free")+
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "ALS incidence (per 100,000)",
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2011, 2020, 1),
    labels = seq(2011, 2020, 1)
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12,face="bold")
  )

ggsave(file.path(path_to_res,"als_inc.pdf"),width = 10, height = 4)

```

z<-1.96

  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,DM_ALS_GLP1,ALS_DM) %>% rename(D=DM_ALS_GLP1,N=ALS_DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "GLP1RAinALSDM",RX_TYPE = 'GLP1RA')) %>%
  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,DM_ALS_DPP4,ALS_DM) %>% rename(D=DM_ALS_DPP4,N=ALS_DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "DPP4inALSDM",RX_TYPE = 'DPP4')) %>%
mutate(
    p = D/N,
    lb = (p+z^2/(2*N)-sqrt((p*(1-p)/N)+z^2/(4*N)))/(1+z^2/N),
    ub = (p+z^2/(2*N)+sqrt((p*(1-p)/N)+z^2/(4*N)))/(1+z^2/N),
  )

ggplot(
  glp1dpp4_100 %>% filter(CALYR < 9999 & DATA_SRC %in% c("EHR","MIX")) %>% 
    mutate(p_rs=p*100,lb_rs=lb*100,ub_rs=ub*100),
  aes(x=CALYR,y=p_rs,color=PREV_TYPE)
) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lb_rs,ymax=ub_rs),width=0.5)+
  facet_wrap(~DATA_SRC+RX_TYPE,ncol=4)+
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "GLP1RA or DPP4 Use Prevelance (%)",
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2011, 2020, 1),
    labels = seq(2011, 2020, 1)
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12,face="bold")
  )

ggsave(file.path(path_to_res,"glpdpp4_prev.pdf"),width = 16, height = 5)

```{r}
#| label: glp1dpp4_als
#| warning: false

glp1dpp4_als_cor<-data.frame(
  CALYR=as.numeric(),
  DATA_SRC=as.character(),
  D=as.numeric(),
  N=as.numeric(),
  PREV_TYPE = as.character(),
  CASE_TYPE = as.character(),
  p=as.numeric(),
  p_norm=as.numeric()
) %>%
  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,DM_ALS_GLP1,ALS_DM) %>% rename(D=DM_ALS_GLP1,N=ALS_DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "GLP1RAinALSDM",CASE_TYPE = 'GLP1RA',p=D/N,p_norm=D/N*100)) %>%
  bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,newALS_DM,DM) %>% rename(D=newALS_DM,N=DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "IncALSinDM",CASE_TYPE = 'IncALS',p=D/N,p_norm=D/N*10000)) %>%
   bind_rows(cnt %>% dplyr::select(CALYR,DATA_SRC,ALS_DM,DM) %>% rename(D=ALS_DM,N=DM) %>% mutate(PREV_TYPE = "ALSinDM",CASE_TYPE = 'PrevALS',p=D/N,p_norm=D/N*10000))


ggplot(
  glp1dpp4_als_cor %>% filter(CALYR < 9999 & DATA_SRC %in% c("EHR","MIX")),
  aes(x=CALYR,y=p_norm,color=CASE_TYPE)
) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  # geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lb_rs,ymax=ub_rs),width=0.5)+
  facet_wrap(~DATA_SRC,ncol=2)+
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "GLP1RA or DPP4 Use Prevelance (%) \n or ALS Incidence or ALS Prevalence (X 10,000)",
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2011, 2020, 1),
    labels = seq(2011, 2020, 1)
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12,face="bold")
  )

ggsave(file.path(path_to_res,"glpdpp4_als.pdf"),width = 10, height = 4)

cor_ehr<-glp1dpp4_als_cor %>%
  filter(DATA_SRC == 'EHR' & CALYR != 9999) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CALYR,CASE_TYPE,p_norm
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = CASE_TYPE,
    values_from = p_norm
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = CALYR-2010
  )

x_trend <- loess(cor_ehr$GLP1RA ~ cor_ehr$t, span = 0.2)$fitted
y_trend <- loess(cor_ehr$IncALS ~ cor_ehr$t, span = 0.2)$fitted

r <- cor(x_trend, y_trend)
n <- length(x_trend)
z <- atanh(r)
se <- 1 / sqrt(n - 3)
z_ci <- z + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(0.975) * se
r_ci <- tanh(z_ci)
r
r_ci



x_trend <- loess(cor_ehr$GLP1RA ~ cor_ehr$t, span = 0.2)$fitted
z_trend <- loess(cor_ehr$PrevALS ~ cor_ehr$t, span = 0.2)$fitted
r <- cor(x_trend, z_trend)
n <- length(x_trend)
z <- atanh(r)
se <- 1 / sqrt(n - 3)
z_ci <- z + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(0.975) * se
r_ci <- tanh(z_ci)
r
r_ci


```
